title: Y9 Advanced — T2W2 Equations: Applications & Advanced Topics

questions.question_katex: \text{The sum of two consecutive integers is 51. What is the smaller integer?} \quad n + (n+1) = 51, \quad 2n = 50

questions.question_katex: \text{A rectangle has perimeter 40 cm. Its length is 4 cm more than its width. What is the width?} \quad 2(w + w+4) = 40, \quad 4w + 8 = 40

questions.question_katex: \text{Three more than four times a number equals 31. What is the number?} \quad 4n + 3 = 31, \quad 4n = 28

questions.question_text: A father is three times as old as his son. The sum of their ages is 56. How old is the son?
questions.question_katex: \text{A father is three times as old as his son. The sum of their ages is 56. How old is the son?} \quad s + 3s = 56, \quad 4s = 56

questions.question_text: Solve x³−8=0 by factoring. How many real solutions?
questions.question_katex: \text{Solve x³−8=0 by factoring. How many real solutions?} \quad (x-2)(x²+2x+4)=0. x²+2x+4: disc=4-16<0. Only x=2.

questions.question_text: Three workers A, B, C can finish a job in 6, 8, 12 days respectively. Working together, how many days?
questions.question_katex: \text{Three workers A, B, C can finish a job in 6, 8, 12 days respectively. Working together, how many days?} \quad \dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{12} = \dfrac{4}{24}+\dfrac{3}{24}+\dfrac{2}{24} = \dfrac{9}{24}=\dfrac{3}{8}. Time=\dfrac{8}{3} days

questions.question_text: A two-digit number: units digit is twice tens digit. Sum of digits is 9. Find the number.
questions.question_katex: \text{A two-digit number: units digit is twice tens digit. Sum of digits is 9. Find the number.} \quad t + 2t = 9, \quad 3t = 9

questions.question_text: A boat goes 30 km upstream in 3 hrs and 30 km downstream in 2 hrs. Speed of current?
questions.question_katex: \text{A boat goes 30 km upstream in 3 hrs and 30 km downstream in 2 hrs. Speed of current?} \quad b-c=10, \quad b+c=15. 2c=5

questions.question_text: A mixture of 20% and 50% alcohol solutions makes 15 L of 30% solution. Litres of 50% solution?
questions.question_katex: \text{A mixture of 20% and 50% alcohol solutions makes 15 L of 30% solution. Litres of 50% solution?} \quad 0.2(15-x)+0.5x=0.3(15), \quad 3-0.2x+0.5x=4.5

questions.question_text: Sum of ages of A and B is 50. Five years ago, A was 3 times B's age. A's current age?
questions.question_katex: \text{Sum of ages of A and B is 50. Five years ago, A was 3 times B's age. A's current age?} \quad A=50-B. 50-B-5=3(B-5), \quad 45-B=3B-15

questions.question_text: Train A leaves at 8 AM at 80 km/h. Train B leaves same station at 9:30 AM at 120 km/h same direction. When does B catch A?
questions.question_katex: \text{Train A leaves at 8 AM at 80 km/h. Train B leaves same station at 9:30 AM at 120 km/h same direction. When does B catch A?} \quad A head start: 1.5\times80=120 km. Relative speed: 40 \dfrac{km}{h}. Time: \dfrac{120}{40}=3 hrs after 9:30 = 12:30 PM

questions.question_text: A rectangular garden: length 4m more than width. 2m wide path around it. Path area = 64 m². Width of garden?
questions.question_katex: \text{A rectangular garden: length 4m more than width. 2m wide path around it. Path area = 64 m². Width of garden?} \quad Total=(w+4)(w+8), \quad garden=w(w+4). Path=(w+4)(w+8)-w(w+4)=(w+4)(w+8-w)=(w+4)(8)=8w+32=64

questions.question_text: A and B invest 5000 and 7000. After 1 year, profit is 3600. A's share?
questions.question_katex: \text{A and B invest 5000 and 7000. After 1 year, profit is 3600. A's share?} \quad A's share = 5/(5+7) \times 3600 = \dfrac{5}{12} \times 3600 = 1500

questions.question_text: A car uses fuel at 8L/100km in city and 5L/100km on highway. Trip: 120km city + 200km highway. Total fuel?
questions.question_katex: \text{A car uses fuel at 8L/100km in city and 5L/100km on highway. Trip: 120km city + 200km highway. Total fuel?} \quad City: 120\times\dfrac{8}{100}=9.6L, \quad Hwy: 200\times\dfrac{5}{100}=10L. Total=19.6L

questions.question_text: Compound interest: $1000 at 10% p.a. for 2 years. Total interest?
questions.question_katex: \text{Compound interest: $1000 at 10% p.a. for 2 years. Total interest?} \quad 1000(1.1)²=1210, \quad interest=210

questions.question_text: A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hands?
questions.question_katex: \text{A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hands?} \quad Hour hand: 90+7.5=97.5°, \quad Minute hand: 90°. Angle=7.5°

questions.question_text: In a GP, first term 3, common ratio 2. Sum of first 6 terms?
questions.question_katex: \text{In a GP, first term 3, common ratio 2. Sum of first 6 terms?} \quad S = 3(2⁶-1)/(2-1) = 3(63) = 189

questions.question_text: A palindrome two-digit number: what are the possible values?
questions.question_katex: \text{A palindrome two-digit number: what are the possible values?} \quad 11, \quad 22

questions.question_text: A right triangle: legs x and (x+7), hypotenuse (x+8). Find x.
questions.question_katex: \text{A right triangle: legs x and (x+7), hypotenuse (x+8). Find x.} \quad x²+(x+7)²=(x+8)², \quad x²+x²+14x+49=x²+16x+64

questions.question_text: If the roots of x²+bx+c=0 are 4 and −3, find b and c.
questions.question_katex: \text{If the roots of x²+bx+c=0 are 4 and −3, find b and c.} \quad b = -(4+(-3)) = -1, \quad c = 4\times(-3) = -12

questions.question_text: For what values of k does x²+6x+k=0 have two distinct real roots?
questions.question_katex: \text{For what values of k does x²+6x+k=0 have two distinct real roots?} \quad Disc = 36-4k > 0, \quad k < 9

questions.question_text: Difference of squares of two numbers is 24. Their sum is 12. Find the larger number.
questions.question_katex: \text{Difference of squares of two numbers is 24. Their sum is 12. Find the larger number.} \quad (a+b)(a-b)=24, \quad 12(a-b)=24

questions.question_text: If α and β are roots of x²−5x+3=0, find α²+β².
questions.question_katex: \text{If α and β are roots of x²−5x+3=0, find α²+β².} \quad α+β=5, \quad αβ=3. α²+β²=(α+β)²-2αβ=25-6=19

questions.question_text: Find the quadratic with roots 1+√2 and 1−√2.
questions.question_katex: \text{Find the quadratic with roots 1+√2 and 1−√2.} \quad Sum=2, \quad product=(1)²-(√2)²=-1. x²-2x-1=0
\text{A projectile: h = −4.9t² + 49t. Max height?} \quad t = \dfrac{49}{9}.8 = 5, \quad h = -4.9(25)+245 = -122.5+245 = 122.5
\text{Solve x²−5x+6 > 0.} \quad (x-2)(x-3)>0, \quad positive outside roots: x<2 or x>3
\text{Solve (x−1)/(x+3) > 0, x ≠ −3.} \quad Both positive: x>1. Both negative: x<-3. Solution: x<-3 or x>1

questions.question_text: For what values of k does kx²+4x+1=0 have no real roots (k≠0)?
questions.question_katex: \text{For what values of k does kx²+4x+1=0 have no real roots (k≠0)?} \quad Disc = 16-4k < 0, \quad k > 4

questions.question_text: Find the range of values of x for which x²−2x−8 < 0 AND x+1 > 0.
questions.question_katex: \text{Find the range of values of x for which x²−2x−8 < 0 AND x+1 > 0.} \quad (x-4)(x+2)<0: -2<x<4. x>-1. Combined: -1<x<4

questions.question_text: If 0 < x < 1, which is largest: x, x², √x, 1/x?
questions.question_katex: \text{If 0 < x < 1, which is largest: x, x², √x, 1/x?} \quad For 0<x<1: \dfrac{1}{x} > 1 > √x > x > x²

questions.question_text: If x > 0, find the minimum value of x + 4/x.
questions.question_katex: \text{If x > 0, find the minimum value of x + 4/x.} \quad AM-GM: x+\dfrac{4}{x} ≥ 2√4 = 4. Min=4 when x=2

questions.question_text: How many integer solutions does |x| + |y| ≤ 2 have?
questions.question_katex: \text{How many integer solutions does |x| + |y| ≤ 2 have?} \quad x=0: y=-2, \quad ...

questions.question_text: If a > b > 0, which is true: a/b > (a+1)/(b+1)?
questions.question_katex: \text{If a > b > 0, which is true: a/b > (a+1)/(b+1)?} \quad a(b+1) vs b(a+1): ab+a vs ab+b. Since a>b, \quad ab+a>ab+b. So \dfrac{a}{b} > (a+1)/(b+1). Always true.

questions.question_text: Solve x³−8=0. How many real solutions?
questions.question_katex: \text{Solve x³−8=0. How many real solutions?} \quad (x-2)(x²+2x+4)=0. Disc of quadratic: 4-16=-12<0. Only x=2.

questions.question_text: If x³−y³=19 and x−y=1, find xy.
questions.question_katex: \text{If x³−y³=19 and x−y=1, find xy.} \quad x³-y³=(x-y)(x²+xy+y²)=1\times(x²+xy+y²)=19. (x-y)²=x²-2xy+y²=1. So x²+y²=1+2xy. Thus 1+2xy+xy=19, \quad 1+3xy=19

questions.question_text: Find the sum of real roots of x³−6x²+11x−6=0.
questions.question_katex: \text{Find the sum of real roots of x³−6x²+11x−6=0.} \quad (x-1)(x-2)(x-3)=0. Roots: 1, \quad 2

questions.question_text: A cube's volume increases by 33.1%. By what % does the side increase?
questions.question_katex: \text{A cube's volume increases by 33.1%. By what % does the side increase?} \quad 1.331 = 1.1³. Side increases by 10%.

questions.question_text: If f(x) = x³−kx+2 and f(1)=0, find k.
questions.question_katex: \text{If f(x) = x³−kx+2 and f(1)=0, find k.} \quad 1-k+2=0, \quad k=3

questions.question_text: x³+ax²+bx−6=0 has roots 1, 2, and 3. Find a+b.
questions.question_katex: \text{x³+ax²+bx−6=0 has roots 1, 2, and 3. Find a+b.} \quad (x-1)(x-2)(x-3)=x³-6x²+11x-6. a=-6, \quad b=11
